title: Sonicraft Mixed Dimensions
description: A mod that combines all the dimensions of Sonic.exe and its alternate-dimensional variants across the multiverse, along with completely original worlds. PLAY MY GAME :)
body:
A mod that brings together all the dimensions of Sonic.exe and its dimensional variants throughout the multiverse, and also a few original ones (if no one has had this idea before, I just hope there are no misunderstandings). It also includes a few references to some very famous creepypastas like Lord X or Rewrite.
(is in beta for servers)
this mod adds 2 new dimensions 
a lot new lore to the game like more structures in the overworld,nether and end
new biomes and more with the time 
currentely version: 1.0.7
